notes.title: Don't Remember is going to Norwegian Game Awards!
notes.content:
[b]We Remembered![/b]

The first patch is LIVE NOW, featuring various bugfixes, new tooltips and a new puzzle for you to solve.

Be sure to check it out with the new, fresh content, and keep telling us if you find more annoying bugs as we try to squash them down, and a big thank you to everyone who has played and reviewed the game <3 !


- Team at Boo! Games

notes.title: Sound Bug
notes.content:
We hear you!

We've noted issues regarding the sound options causing the sound to become distorted and extremely boosted. We will be temporarily disabling the options tab until a fix is found. 
Apologies for the inconvenience.
